notes.title: Mod Hackathon Contest with $5,000 in Prizes 💵
notes.content:
Hi Warsmiths and soon to be... Modsmiths! 

We’ve added Modding to Dwerve so you can customize sprites, animations, and stats for the turrets, enemies, and your favorite blue-haired tinkerer, Dwerve. To celebrate, we’re calling all Modsmiths to forge their finest mods in a week-long Hackathon contest with $5,000 USD worth of prizes. Read the details below and make sure to submit your mod on or before July 6!

[h2]💸 What You Can Win![/h2]

We’re giving away $5,000 worth of prizes to 20+ winners! Here’s the prize tiers:
[list]
[*] Top 3 Mod creators each win $1000 USD cash prize
[*] Next top 20 Mod creators get $100 USD Steam Gift Card
[/list]
[previewyoutube=OYLlXvnXqnM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🔧 How to Enter![/h2]

To participate in the Hackathon, [url=https://github.com/HalfHumanGames/DwerveMods]create and upload your mod[/url] to CurseForge and then upload a short video to YouTube, Twitter, or TikTok introducing your mod to the Dwerve community! Here are a couple of mod ideas to consider:
[list]
[*] Reskin the current sprites for a turret, enemy, or Dwerve to create a new look
[*] Craft a new gameplay experience with an overhaul to turret and enemy stats
[*] Forge a new turret with a complete reskin and restat of a current turret or trap
[/list]
Make sure to tag @HalfHumanGames and #Dwerve for your video upload! The video can be short, even a minute or two. Use it to show off your cool creation to others and let them know where to download it. Add a link to your video on your mod’s CurseForge page and vice versa.
[olist]
[*] Create and upload a mod to CurseForge on or before July 6
[*] Upload a video introducing your mod to YouTube, Twitter, or TikTok on or before July 6
[*] Your mod’s CurseForge page must include a link to the video
[/olist]
[previewyoutube=0PtbafPWmwE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🤯 How We’ll Choose Winners![/h2]

While we encourage you to share and promote your mod, this is not a popularity contest. Peter and I will select our favorite mods based on the criteria below. Your mod does not need to meet every single criteria, we encourage you to focus on one or two:
[list]
[*] [b]Creativity:[/b] Did you use the mod tools in a unique way to create a compelling experience?
[*] [b]Game design:[/b] Did you improve upon or create a brand new gameplay experience?
[*] [b]Comedy:[/b] Did you make a funny mod that makes players laugh and have fun despite balancing?
[*] [b]Aesthetic:[/b] Did you create your own beautiful sprite/animations for a turret, enemy, or Dwerve?
[/list]
Happy crafting, Modsmiths! We look forward to seeing what cool creations you come up with. May the best tinkerers win!

notes.title: 15% off + New Modding Support (BETA)!

Get Dwerve for 15% off for the Spring Sale which lasts from March 16 to March 23! To kickoff the sale, we have launched the New Modding Support (Beta)! Anyone can access the Beta via the "mods" branch on Steam and check it out now! Help us find bugs and make improvements. 😊

[h1]🪛 Modding Support (Beta)[/h1]

The mod system lets you customize the stats and sprites for Dwerve, towers, and enemies. You can also mod the general game configuration which determines when towers, power stones, and artifacts get unlocked. For example, you could reskin a turret, and have it deal massive knockback! 🥊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/3514b7fd2d5f703972203629b5531e04abfa6486.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]All Artifacts[/b] - Unlock all artifacts
[*] [b]Anytime Dash[/b] - No dash cooldown!
[*] [b]Complete Arsenal[/b] - Unlock all turrets and traps!
[*] [b]Endless Smash[/b] - Smash however often you'd like!
[*] [b]Forever Traps[/b] - Traps last until you recall them!
[*] [b]Funny Chakram[/b] - Chakrams travel slowly but send enemies flying!
[*] [b]Long-Range Scattershot[/b] - Increase the default range of the scattershot!
[*] [b]Red Hair[/b] - Give Dwerve red hair!
[*] [b]Turd Slimes[/b] - All slimes are turds!
[*] [b]Super Fast Walk[/b] - Dwerve walks super fast!
[*] [b]Ten Power Stones[/b] - Gives you 10 power stones!
[*] [b]Wicked Fast Wargboars[/b] - Makes wargboars wicked fast!
[/list]
[h2]🧑🏼‍🦰 Red Hair[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/6b301b90559031e69c6ea85eee3acd694219d3d8.png[/img]

[h2]💩 Turd Slimes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/f27824fa7bd29bc6eb090e0d2a812b6fcf85b27b.png[/img]

[h1]🗝️ How to Access[/h1]

1️⃣ To switch to the "mods" branch in the Steam client, right-click on "Dwerve" from the library page and select "Properties". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/0d0f3492f6b060735577a98379f0c950fdb95b18.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dwerve is 15% off! New Quality of Life Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi Warsmiths!

[h2]15% Discount![/h2]

Dwerve is 15% off until November 14 as part of two back-to-back Steam events: IndieCade and Indie X!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132760/Dwerve/

To kickoff these events, we've released a new Quality of Life Update! 5 months after launch, we've continued to work hard to improve the game with the help of our community! Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback! ❤️

[h2]5 Month Progress[/h2]

Here's some of the key changes we've made over the past few months:

- Balanced a ton of turrets, upgrades, and enemies
- Streamlined levels design for more fluid progression
- Improved battles to offer a more strategic experience
- Removed redundant or tedious puzzles
- Removed unnecessary dialogues for less interruption
- Increased Dwerve's movement speed — several times!
- Added a ton of more graphics and UX options
- Added ability to move through your own turrets
- Added selling upgrades back at full price
- Added more health potions and armor drops
- Added backtracking to collect missed keys
- Added build preview to see where your turret will get built
- Added recall preview to see which turret will get recalled
- Added ability to skip dialogues and fast-forward cutscenes
- Added exclamation particles to indicate battle triggers
- Optimized the build size
- Made all sneak sections optional
- Fixed a gazillion bugs

We're happy with how much the game has improved thanks to you all! Now we can focus on new features like.... [b]* drum roll *[/b] ...

[h2]Classic TD Mode![/h2]

Classic TD is a new upcoming game mode that has traditional tower defense gameplay. Build more and more turrets over time to defeat waves of enemies before they reach the objective. The game mode is currently in Beta testing but will be released as part of the main game in the coming weeks!

notes.title: New Bundles + Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi Warsmiths!

Today we're announcing 2 new bundles for Dwerve!

[h1]Dwerve + Soundtrack[/h1]

Enjoy the adventurous and emotional music of Dwerve composed by Mordi (Martin Lande). Dwerve (Original Soundtrack) features 30+ songs that highlight the whimsical lands, unforgettable characters, and exciting narrative points that the player experiences in the epic action-adventure RPG.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26329/Dwerve__Soundtrack_Bundle/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26329/Dwerve__Soundtrack_Bundle/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26329/Dwerve__Soundtrack_Bundle/[/url]

[h1]Dwerve + Builder Simulator[/h1]

Builder Simulator is the perfect game for those who want to build a house, from the ground up, one brick at a time.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26596/Build_your_Dungeon/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26596/Build_your_Dungeon/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26596/Build_your_Dungeon/[/url]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

Just because Dwerve has launched does not mean our journey has ended. This is just the beginning! In addition to quality of life updates, we have some other cool stuff panned:

[h2]Boss Rush Mode[/h2]

This game mode has you face off against each of the bosses with special conditions and modifiers. We're still exploring different options for how this game mode will function, but I'm sure you all will enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/143a9a811927a52702a5e1abfce10231bac8d109.gif[/img]

[h2]World Map[/h2]

Whether it's to unlock a chest you missed, complete an achievement, or visit the Hall of Heroes to read the Kickstarter backer quotes, the World Map will let you replay any level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/b11e25b973defcb4a1ddb66a92ad24dc2a99cb85.gif[/img]

[h1]Give Us Feedback[/h1]

Thank you all for supporting us! Our team is hard at work fixing bugs and improving the game based on your feedback. If you have any suggestions for improving the game, please let us know on Discord:

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/halfhumangames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/161e36cb87c6032a13fe4680447d544a3620db6d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dwerve selected for PAX Rising Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
Hi, Warsmiths!

We have some exciting news: Dwerve has been selected for [url=https://aus.paxsite.com/en-us/features/pax-rising.html]PAX Rising[/url], so we'll be at PAX East! Don't worry, other fantastic and long-awaited news is coming soonish too. Our party of humble devs can see the light at the end of the dungeon!

[h2]Dwerve Makes PAX Rising![/h2]

PAX Rising showcases indie games that PAX believes have the chance to rise about their modest beginnings, by growing as a company, establishing a fan base or pushing the industry. PAX East takes place at the Boston Convention & Exhibition Center from Thursday, April 21 through Sunday, April 24. If you want to attend PAX EAST and hang out with us in person, you can [url=https://east.paxsite.com/en-us/registration.html#attendee-registration]purchase badges here[/url]. 

[h2]Dev Update + Cool Art![/h2]

In case you missed our last [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/halfhumangames/dwerve-tower-defense-dungeon-crawler-rpg/posts]Kickstarter updates[/url], here's a summary of what we've been working on this year so far!

[h3]⭐ Turret & Trap Upgrades[/h3]

Awhile back we gave Sla's Shop, where you use scrap to upgrade your turrets and traps, a big UI makeover (these icons are placeholder):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/62e3b394227280efa542ae25b14f2c47843df50a.gif[/img]

We also designed all of the turret & trap upgrades! Each turret & trap has its own upgrade tree with a total of 100+ upgrades! Check out the actual upgrade icons (adding in soon) that Enchae just finished:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/159487272e04a0fefa0e9e9f5df3dcfc3afbdd38.png[/img]

[h3]🔥 Hero Abilities & Artifacts[/h3]

We also implemented all of the artifacts, which give Dwerve abilities, some active and some passive! Check out the artifact icons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/97848ef8cf272bfe4d5d85d7af6ea272d5b07806.png[/img]

Here you can see the Warhammer Smash in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/718757747cc731a6198928ca75ce0d81bc2675f6.gif[/img]

[h3]👄 Localization[/h3]

Translators have localized a majority of the game to Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/fda48744e2db8d35b5abcf208c35eaf5913b1e01.png[/img]

[h3]🌎 World Map[/h3]

All of the world maps are done for each biome! Now we're implementing the world map in-game. Here's the overworld map of the above-surface locations:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/159487272e04a0fefa0e9e9f5df3dcfc3afbdd38.png[/img]

And here's a preview of the Fungi Caves biome which is inside the mountain:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/02f472c13fea95fa3dd0fe1f8e404034daeb921c.png[/img]

[h3]🎨 Updating Art Assets[/h3]

We've spent a lot of time adding and improving art assets! We want the game to look amazing! Check out this Gnobling Shrine:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/73925a310931824b2287e2dbcee007288decf0b8.png[/img]

We've also been giving the character portraits a makeover:

[b]Esben (Dwerve's Grandpa)[/b]

[b]Karvemup the Butcher[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/c879304c4a5c17f1c10ba5fc0ca2e22acdf39086.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/67d2922f1b947f83d86c30206a589b80852ecb7b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Meet our Writer! + Update on Launch
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! It has been a fun and productive year for us so far! Despite the immense progress we have made, we have unfortunate news to share regarding the launch. On the flip side, we have exciting news as well: Mladen, a narrative designer and game writer has joined our team to breathe life into the characters and world! We want to show you all that we have been working on and discuss the delay in more detail to make sure we are as transparent as possible with you all.

[h1]Meet Mladen! 🖋️[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/563d75305b310f3f0b04f1326ea90449e3520c93.png[/img]

[h3]Mladen Duric | Narrative Design & Writing | [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/mladen-duric-9206b796/]LinkedIn[/url][/h3]

Mladen is a professional narrative designer and game writer from Serbia! He has worked in the industry for over 5 years and contributed to titles like Warlander. He has joined our team to help us design the world, story, characters, and locations. He will breathe life into these by writing the dialogues for the game, as well as the text for interactable items that you can discover while exploring the levels. He will also collaborate with Peter and Enchae on visual storytelling to make sure each location reveals more about the lore of the world.

[h1]Dev Update[/h1]

[h3]⌨️ Programming | Percy[/h3]

I (Percy) have been implementing miscellaneous features like proper graphics settings, remapping controls, improved controller support, and difficulty settings! Our Beta Testers have also kept me busy with bug reports. I have been fixing tons and tons of bugs! On a more fun note: I just added the harpoon turret! Now all turrets and enemies are in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/fffd3866897d036898487764eda2d254184cbd45.gif[/img]

[h3]🕹️ Level Design | Peter[/h3]

Peter has been hard at work building levels. This includes painting tilemaps, designing battles, crafting puzzles, hiding secrets, setting up cutscenes, and of course playing through the levels over and over again to make sure it all works just right! He works closely with Mladen to make sure the levels align with the narrative, and with Enchae to make sure we get all of the art needed for each level. After we get bug reports and feedback from the Beta Testers, he iterates on the levels to fix bugs and make improvements. It's a very long and tough process. While we don't want to show any level spoilers, we're happy to note that we are more than halfway done with the levels!

[h3]🎨 Art | Enchae [/h3]

Enchae has been working on art for key locations like this... Hmmm! What could this be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/79cb071373b83f1ed2d06272a1ad0db88df59081.png[/img]

And environmental props for the different biomes, like this flaming tree!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/e7516059a368d84454ac68acb986634a5660d1d0.png[/img]

And this building! I wonder where one might discover such fine architecture...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35585514/b1a68c4818fdba07f3c406b24a514cb19ecda2d2.png[/img]

[h3]🎵 Audio | Mordi [/h3]

Mordi will not leave any stone unturned! He has updated all of the turret and enemy sounds, making sure to replace any shared sounds with personalized ones. Now, events like building a turret provide unique audio feedback depending on which turret it is.  Check out the sounds!

[previewyoutube=kE9R9Xp2E_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

He has also been implementing dynamic music that seamlessly transitions from one section to another by adding and removing layers of music. Give the Fort Stonewall preview a listen!

[h3][url=https://soundcloud.com/mordi-1/dwerve-fort-stonewall-preview]🎵 Fort Stonewall (preview) 🎵[/url][/h3]

[h3]📝 Writing | Mladen [/h3]

Over the past couple of weeks, Mladen has helped us expand upon the history and lore of the world, elaborate on characters and locations, and refine the overall storyline. He just finished writing the dialogues for one of the chapters, and we have to say: it has been exciting to see those designs and ideas translate to in-game experiences. We can't wait for you all to experience the story of Dwerve!

[h1]Launch[/h1]

Unfortunately Dwerve won't be ready by summer. Since AAA games market aggressively during the holiday season, we cannot launch over fall or winter either. Press and influencers are crucial to indie game success. During the holiday season, press and influences cover all of the AAA titles that are released over the holidays. We don't want to risk Dwerve not getting enough coverage at launch, because we want Dwerve to do well so we can continue to make awesome games for you all. Therefore, we have made the difficult decision to delay the launch until early 2022.

While the game itself will likely be done over summer, other important tasks like the Switch port, localizations, and QA will require more time. We want to assure you all that we are, to the best of our abilities, working hard to make sure that Dwerve is the best possible game it can be. After 3.5 years of development, we have grown even more passionate and excited to make Dwerve a reality. This unfortunate but necessary delay will give us more time to make sure we can realize our complete vision for Dwerve.

[b]Dwerve is a tower defense dungeon crawler RPG.[/b] It tells the story of a young dwarven tinkerer that adventures into dwarven ruins to unearth the lost technologies of the ancient warsmiths - turrets and traps, the only weapons that can protect the dwarves from the witch queen known as Vandra the Wicked and her army of bloodthirsty trolls and monstrous creatures.

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*]  [b]Tactical turret-based combat.[/b] Combat involves making strategic decisions about which turrets and traps to build and where. During a battle you must rebuild, swap out, and reposition turrets to adapt to new waves of enemies and a dynamic battlefield!

[*]  [b]Explore ancient dungeons.[/b] Explore 30+ dungeons in 5+ biomes, each with hidden secrets, mysterious puzzles, and interesting lore!
[/list]

notes.title: Watch Pixel Pete Play Dwerve!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the first public playable version of Dwerve will be made available for 1 week during the Steam Games Festival which lasts from June 16 to June 22!

Watch Pixel Pete Play Dwerve on June 17 at 11 am ET/GMT-4!

[b]Dwerve is a tower defense dungeon crawler RPG.[/b] It tells the story of a young dwarven tinkerer that adventures into dwarven ruins to unearth the lost technologies of the ancient warsmiths - turrets and traps, the only weapons that can protect the dwarves from the witch queen known as Vandra the Wicked and her army of bloodthirsty trolls and monstrous creatures.

Inspired by the SNES classics we grew up playing, Dwerve takes all the RPG mechanics you know and love like dungeon crawling, looting, questing, exploring, and storytelling, and presents it with a new style of tactical turret-based combat.

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*]  [b]Tactical turret-based combat.[/b] Combat involves making strategic decisions about which turrets and traps to build and where. During a battle you must rebuild, swap out, and reposition turrets to adapt to new waves of enemies and a dynamic battlefield!
[*]  [b]Upgrade your arsenal.[/b] Unlock 15+ turrets, each with it's own unique upgrade tree. Purchase upgrades that make the turrets stronger. You decide which turret upgrades best cater to your favorite strategies and play style!
[*]  [b]Discover powerful artifacts.[/b] Discover all 5+ artifacts — an arrow-blocking shield, dashing boots, a bouncing boomerang, a ground-shaking hammer, and more! These artifacts give the player special abilities to fight and outmaneuver foes!
[*]  [b]Fully dynamic lighting.[/b] Explore dimly lit dungeons that come to life with dynamic lights and shadows that offers a modernized take on SNES-inspired graphics that pushes the boundaries of pixel art games!
[*]  [b]Story-based campaign.[/b] Unravel the history of the dwarves and the trolls in a story that features diverse characters, unpredictable plot, and a fantasy world with it's own mythology!
[*]  [b]Explore ancient dungeons.[/b] Explore 30+ dungeons in 5+ biomes, each with hidden secrets, mysterious puzzles, and interesting lore!
[*]  [b]Dynamic battlefield.[/b] Engage in combat on a dynamic battlefield that changes as you fight with obstacles collapsing, falling from the ceiling, and emerging from the ground!
[*]  [b]Solve challenging puzzles.[/b] Want to get extra loot or lore? Solve an optional puzzle! Or don't — it's up to you.
[*]  [b]Complete daring quests.[/b] Each dungeon has its own specific story-based objectives that you must complete to to progress the story.
[*]  [b]Loot corpses and treasure chests.[/b] Collect health potions, scrap, armor, and other useful items from the bloodsoaked corpses of your slain enemies!
[/list]

notes.title: Join the developers for an AMA!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the first public playable version of Dwerve will be made available for 1 week during the Steam Games Festival which lasts from June 16 to June 22!

We're kicking off the event on June 16 at 1 PM ET/GMT-4 with:
[list]
[*] Pixel Pete streaming Dwerve on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132760/Dwerve/]Steam page[/url]
[*] PJ doing an AMA on the Half Human Games [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/halfhumangames]Discord server[/url]
[/list]

[b]Dwerve is a tower defense dungeon crawler RPG.[/b] It tells the story of a young dwarven tinkerer that adventures into dwarven ruins to unearth the lost technologies of the ancient warsmiths - turrets and traps, the only weapons that can protect the dwarves from the witch queen known as Vandra the Wicked and her army of bloodthirsty trolls and monstrous creatures.

Inspired by the SNES classics we grew up playing, Dwerve takes all the RPG mechanics you know and love like dungeon crawling, looting, questing, exploring, and storytelling, and presents it with a new style of tactical turret-based combat.

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*]  [b]Tactical turret-based combat.[/b] Combat involves making strategic decisions about which turrets and traps to build and where. During a battle you must rebuild, swap out, and reposition turrets to adapt to new waves of enemies and a dynamic battlefield!
[*]  [b]Upgrade your arsenal.[/b] Unlock 15+ turrets, each with it's own unique upgrade tree. Purchase upgrades that make the turrets stronger. You decide which turret upgrades best cater to your favorite strategies and play style!
[*]  [b]Discover powerful artifacts.[/b] Discover all 5+ artifacts — an arrow-blocking shield, dashing boots, a bouncing boomerang, a ground-shaking hammer, and more! These artifacts give the player special abilities to fight and outmaneuver foes!
[*]  [b]Fully dynamic lighting.[/b] Explore dimly lit dungeons that come to life with dynamic lights and shadows that offers a modernized take on SNES-inspired graphics that pushes the boundaries of pixel art games!
[*]  [b]Story-based campaign.[/b] Unravel the history of the dwarves and the trolls in a story that features diverse characters, unpredictable plot, and a fantasy world with it's own mythology!
[*]  [b]Explore ancient dungeons.[/b] Explore 30+ dungeons in 5+ biomes, each with hidden secrets, mysterious puzzles, and interesting lore!
[*]  [b]Dynamic battlefield.[/b] Engage in combat on a dynamic battlefield that changes as you fight with obstacles collapsing, falling from the ceiling, and emerging from the ground!
[*]  [b]Solve challenging puzzles.[/b] Want to get extra loot or lore? Solve an optional puzzle! Or don't — it's up to you.
[*]  [b]Complete daring quests.[/b] Each dungeon has its own specific story-based objectives that you must complete to to progress the story.
[*]  [b]Loot corpses and treasure chests.[/b] Collect health potions, scrap, armor, and other useful items from the bloodsoaked corpses of your slain enemies!
[/list]
